Given the sets $P={1,2,3,4}$ and  $S={2,3,4,5,6}$ shown above, find $P-S.$
worked_solution:
The difference $P-S$ consists of all the elements that are in $P$ but not $S.$ To represent $P-S,$ we will shade in all the area that is contained in $P$ but not $S.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14037357/assets/3e25daddd75613f6e85f9f46d68f463876edd50f7df11961de8b53e108d5fd88.png)

Only the element $1$ is in $P$  but not $S.$

Therefore, the difference is

$$
P-S={1}.
$$
